zh.title: 俄伊爾20偵察機涉侵犯芬蘭領空 邊境衛隊展開調查
zh.summary: 芬蘭國防部指俄羅斯伊爾20偵察機涉侵領空；邊境衛隊已啟動初步調查。
body: 芬蘭國防部表示，一架俄羅斯伊爾-20（Ilyushin Il-20）偵察機涉嫌於2026年8月20日下午，在芬蘭灣西部上空侵犯芬蘭領空。芬蘭邊境衛隊隨後確認該架涉案機型為伊爾-20電偵機。
芬蘭邊境衛隊於8月21日發布聲明指出，這起疑似領空侵犯事件持續約3分鐘，該架飛機深入芬蘭領土最遠達約4.7海浬（接近9公里），地點位於烏特島（Utö）以南的芬蘭灣西部海域。
芬蘭國防部長哈卡寧（Antti Häkkänen）表示，官方重視每起疑似侵犯領土事件並已展開調查。邊境衛隊目前已啟動初步調查程序，待完成後將對外說明調查結果。

en.title: Finland Investigates Suspected Airspace Violation by Russian Il-20 Reconnaissance Aircraft
en.summary: Finland's defense ministry investigates a suspected three-minute airspace violation by a Russian Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft.
body: Finland's Ministry of Defense said a Russian Ilyushin Il-20 reconnaissance aircraft is suspected of violating Finnish airspace over the western Gulf of Finland on the afternoon of August 20, 2026. The Finnish Border Guard subsequently identified the aircraft involved in the incident.

According to a statement issued by the Border Guard on August 21, 2026, the suspected territorial violation lasted approximately three minutes. The aircraft reached a maximum depth of about 4.7 nautical miles, or just under nine kilometers, inside Finnish territory south of Utö island.

Defense Minister Antti Häkkänen stated that all suspected territorial violations are taken seriously and an investigation is underway. The Finnish Border Guard has launched a preliminary investigation and will release its findings once completed.
